title: krn lane finish ships a pushed lane branch that hit its turn ceiling
body:
Source: lead session 2026-11-16: a lane hit its turn ceiling after pushing its branch but before shipping (slop-prune-dead); the lead had to rebuild the body, the Weakens-tests line and the ship call by hand.
Outcome: `krn lane finish <slug>` ships a pushed lane branch from its worktree with the lane's recorded body inputs (task, refs or ticket from the commit trailer, assumptions and weakens-tests notes the lane wrote to its worktree state), and lanes.md tells a lane near its ceiling to write those notes before it stops.
Why: an unshipped lane branch costs a lead several turns and context.
Proof: a lane test with a pushed fixture branch and recorded notes runs finish against a fake gh and gets `verdict: merged`; without notes it derives the trailer and still ships.
Files: src/cli/lane.ts, .agents/skills/delivery-lead/lanes.md, src/adopt/skills/delivery-lead/lanes.md
